title: TIDE: Tuning-Integrated Dynamic Evolution for LLM-Based Automated Heuristic Design

mechanism.domainTask: LLM-based automated heuristic design for combinatorial optimization with joint logic and parameter search
mechanism.populationDetail: Six independent islands each maintain a population of eight heuristics; TSED topology mediates migration and reset.
mechanism.archiveDetail: A global elite population preserves top-performing algorithm backbones and optimized constants; exact capacity is not specified.
mechanism.replacementDetail: Within each island valid offspring are merged and the pool is rank-sorted and truncated to top performers; global elites also retain tuned constants. TSED controls adaptive code/insight migration and fusion resets.
mechanism.generationDetail: Structural LLM generation includes exploratory synthesis, backbone consensus, topology/scoring/parsimony mutations, plus a fusion reset combining global elite and local incumbent; numeric parameters are separately optimized by DE.
mechanism.feedbackDetail: Heuristic objective cost/fitness and relative fitness improvement drive survival and UCB reward updates; TSED and stagnation statistics guide migration and reset.
mechanism.parentSelectionDetail: Crossover uses tournament selection from the local island; mutation prioritizes the incumbent elite; reset combines global elite and local incumbent. A single parent count does not describe all operations.
mechanism.outOfTaxonomy: The nested separation of symbolic heuristic structure generation from continuous parameter refinement via differential evolution, and TSED-based dual-mode code/insight migration, are distinctive coupled mechanisms not fully expressed by the current generation/population categories.

provenance.sourcePdf: papers/TIDE Tuning-Integrated Dynamic Evolution for LLM-Based Automated Heuristic Design.pdf
provenance.citationWarning: Do not conflate DE's numeric parameter mutation/crossover with LLM prompt-generation mechanisms; it is a separate inner optimizer. Parent count varies by prompt operation, and full prompt templates are not exposed.
